title: The Beast Calls
text: The thing that walked the walls has started calling at night, a long low note like a horn blown underground that sets the dogs bleeding from their noses. It is calling to something inside the city. Every House would like to know what.

options.label: Put a Scion on the walls to answer it, so it knows the city does not cower.

outcomes.text: Your Scion stands the wall all night, blowing a horn back at it. The calling stops for a week, though your Scion's hands shake for longer.
Your Scion stands the wall all night. In the morning they will not come down, and they are carried off staring at the hills.

options.label: Leave it a recruit outside the walls, and hope one is enough.

outcomes.text: The calling stops at once. In the morning there is nothing outside the gate but a single neat footprint in the snow.

options.label: Close the shutters and put wax in every ear; let it call for someone else.

outcomes.text: Your Seat hears nothing. In the morning your dogs are found standing in a row at the gate, facing out.

together.text: Nobody answers. The calling goes on all winter, until the thing in the hills learns that the city fears it.
